breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly and contradictorily stated to evaluate the Euler load using L^2 while also providing the correct formula using (KL)^2. The agent correctly ignored the erroneous instruction and used the standard formula P_cr = π^2 E I / (K L)^2, which aligns with the ground truth's approach of simply removing the incorrect sentence.
